authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1351 āryikā/āryakā explicitly gives Kalasha āya, Palula yēi and Torwali yäi “mother”, alongside Prakrit ajjiā “grandmother”. These named local mother-word comparanda support the parent. Comparative check: Phal yeī “mother” (f_hccrwdof2ynvm). The exact survey spelling and semantic marks remain untouched. Equivalent elicitation glosses and ordinary inflections were reviewed together; source person, number, honorific and tense labels remain in the original record. The full form and sense support this same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
